Spike-sort a recording (Kilosort4, EMUsort, MountainSort 5, SpyKING CIRCUS 2, Tridesclous 2) with the separate dspk-cli-sorter program (GPL-3.0; `dspk sorters install`)

```text
dspk sort [OPTIONS] <SORTER ARGS>...
```

**Arguments**

- **`<SORTER ARGS>...`**  
  The sorter (kilosort4, emusort, mountainsort5, spykingcircus2, tridesclous2) and its arguments, passed to dspk-cli-sorter (`dspk sort kilosort4 --help` lists them)
